title: Enjoying Tapas
text: We had a wonderful leader and great company. We enjoyed learning and seeing the gothic area of Barcelona, not least of all, we enjoyed  amazing tapas in specialist tapa restaurants .
author: Alison W

title: Amazing Tour!
text: You think it might be obvious stuff about Spanish/Catalan culture but honestly blew our minds! Eye opening, delicious, convivial, perfect :)
